arxiv-2111-11381.title: Spatial Correlation in Weather Forecast Accuracy: A Functional Time Series Approach
arxiv-2111-11381.creator: Phillip A. Jang, David S. Matteson
arxiv-2111-11381.description: Abstract A functional time series approach is proposed for investigating spatial correlation in daily maximum temperature forecast errors for 111 cities spread across the U.S. The modelling of spatial correlation is most fruitful for longer forecast horizons, and becomes less relevant as the forecast horizon shrinks towards zero.

arxiv-2203-02026.title: Provable and Efficient Continual Representation Learning
arxiv-2203-02026.creator: Yingcong Li yli692@ucr.edu, Mingchen Li mli176@ucr.edu, M. Salman Asif sasif@ece.ucr.edu, Samet Oymak oymak@ece.ucr.edu
arxiv-2203-02026.description: Abstract In continual learning (CL), the goal is to design models that can learn a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting. Despite rich set of CL techniques, relatively little understanding exists on how representations built by previous tasks benefit new tasks that are added to the network.

arxiv-2306-05478.title: Trajectory Prediction with Observations of Variable-Length for Motion Planning in Highway Merging Scenarios*
arxiv-2306-05478.creator: Sajjad Mozaffari, MReza Alipour Sormoli, Konstantinos Koufos, Graham Lee, Mehrdad Dianati
arxiv-2306-05478.description: Abstract Accurate trajectory prediction of nearby vehicles is crucial for the safe motion planning of automated vehicles in dynamic driving scenarios such as highway merging. Existing methods cannot initiate prediction for a vehicle unless observed for a fixed duration of two or more seconds.

arxiv-2312-12240.title: The pseudochiral Fermi surface of α \alpha -RuI 3
arxiv-2312-12240.creator: Alex Louat, Matthew D. Watson, Timur K. Kim, Danrui Ni, Robert J. Cava, Cephise Cacho
arxiv-2312-12240.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alex Louat, Matthew D. Watson, Timur K. Kim, Danrui Ni, Robert J. Cava, Cephise Cacho. Abstract In continuation of research into RuCl 3 and RuBr 3 as potential quantum spin liquids, a phase with unique magnetic order characterised by long-range quantum entanglement and fractionalised excitations, the compound RuI 3 has been recently synthesised. Here, we show RuI 3 is a moderately correlated metal with two bands crossing the Fermi level, implying the absence of any quantum spin liquids phase.

arxiv-2407-03175.title: Low-Rank Toeplitz Matrix Restoration: Descent Cone Analysis and Structured Random Matrix
arxiv-2407-03175.creator: Song Li
arxiv-2407-03175.description: Abstract This note demonstrates that we can stably recover all symmetric Toeplitz matrices 𝑿 0 ∈ ℝ n × n \boldsymbol{X}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n} of rank at most r r from a number of rank-one subgaussian measurements on the order of r ​ log 2 ​ n r\log^{2}n with an exponentially decreasing failure probability by employing a nuclear norm minimization program.

arxiv-2407-09061.title: Spectral Self-supervised Feature Selection
arxiv-2407-09061.creator: Daniel Segal segaldaniel23@gmail.com, Ofir Lindenbaum ofirlin@gmail.com, Ariel Jaffe ariel.jaffe@mail.huji.ac.il
arxiv-2407-09061.description: Abstract Choosing a meaningful subset of features from high-dimensional observations in unsupervised settings can greatly enhance the accuracy of downstream analysis tasks, such as clustering or dimensionality reduction, and provide valuable insights into the sources of heterogeneity in a given dataset. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised graph-based approach for unsupervised feature selection.

arxiv-2502-05274.title: Nucleon axial, tensor, and scalar charges and σ \sigma -terms in lattice QCD
arxiv-2502-05274.creator: Gregoris Spanoudes
arxiv-2502-05274.description: Abstract We determine the nucleon axial, scalar and tensor charges at the continuum limit by analyzing three N f = 2 + 1 + 1 N_{f}=2+1+1 twisted mass fermion ensembles with all quark masses tuned to approximately their physical values. We include all contributions from valence and sea quarks.

arxiv-2509-05534.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The 2012 discovery of the Higgs boson [ 1 , 2 ] at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) marked a major milestone for the Standard Model (SM), confirming its predictions in both the hadron and leptonic sectors.

arxiv-2512-13115.title: Quantum-inspired Chemical Rule for Discovering Topological Materials
arxiv-2512-13115.creator: Xinyu Xu, Rajibul Islam, Ghulam Hussain, Yangming Huang, Xiaoguang Li, Pavlo O. Dral, Arif Ullah, Ming Yang
arxiv-2512-13115.description: Abstract Topological materials exhibit unique electronic structures that underpin both fundamental quantum phenomena and next-generation technologies, yet their discovery remains constrained by the high computational cost of first-principles calculations and the slow, resource-intensive nature of experimental synthesis. Recent machine-learning approaches, such as the heuristic topogivity rule, offer data-driven alternatives by quantifying each element’s intrinsic tendency toward topological behavior.

arxiv-2512-16273.title: Fast Collaborative Inference via Distributed Speculative Decoding
arxiv-2512-16273.creator: Ce ZHENG, Ke ZHANG, Sun CHEN, Wenqi ZHANG, Qiong LIU, Angesom Ataklity Tesfay
arxiv-2512-16273.description: Abstract Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by allowing a small draft model to predict multiple future tokens for verification by a larger target model. In AI-native radio access networks (AI-RAN), this enables device–edge collaborative inference but introduces significant uplink overhead, as existing distributed speculative decoding schemes transmit full vocabulary logits at every step.

pmc-10633911.title: The effect of simulation-based advanced cardiac life support training on nursing students’ self-efficacy, attitudes, and anxiety in Palestine: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-10633911.creator: Maysa Fareed Kassabry
pmc-10633911.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundCardiac Arrest (CA) is one of the leading causes of death, either inside or outside hospitals. Recently, the use of creative teaching strategies, such as simulation, has gained popularity in Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) instruction. This study aimed to assess the effect of High-Fidelity Simulation (HFS) training on nursing students’ self-efficacy, attitude, and anxiety in the context of Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS).MethodologyThe study design is quasi-experimental employing a pre-test and post-test approach during April and May 2023.

pmc-11336608.title: Clinical effect and prognosis of transoral or endoscope-assisted transoral release for irreducible atlantoaxial dislocation: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-11336608.creator: Zhaojun Song, Kai Zhang, Guangzhou Li, Zhi Zhang, Jiazhuang Zheng, Maobo Ran, Juan Luo, Zhiqiang Wang, Wenzhi Chen
pmc-11336608.description: BackgroundThe clinical applications of endoscope-assisted transoral release for irreducible atlantoaxial dislocations are limited. This study aimed to investigate the clinical effect and prognostic factors of traditional and endoscope-assisted transoral release, as well as posterior reduction and fixation, in treating irreducible atlantoaxial dislocations.

pmc-11523604.title: Effect of topical magnesium sulfate on labor duration and childbirth experience: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11523604.creator: Sahar Rouhzendeh, Sanaz Mousavi, Mojgan Mirghafourvand, Sakineh Mohammad-Alizadeh-Charandabi
pmc-11523604.description: BackgroundMagnesium sulfate is used topically to reduce the duration of labor in some regions of the country. However, there is insufficient evidence about its effectiveness. This study aimed to determine whether topical magnesium sulfate reduces labor duration and improves childbirth experience (primary outcomes).

pmc-12381128.title: High performance grid structured MIMO antenna with regression machine learning for high-speed sub THz and THz 6G IoT applications
pmc-12381128.creator: Jamal Hossain Nirob, Isha Das, Kamal Hossain Nahin, Jun-Jiat Tiang, Mouaaz Nahas, Narinderjit Singh Sawaran Singh, Md. Ashraful Haque
pmc-12381128.description: This study introduces an innovative approach that leverages machine learning techniques to optimize antenna gain for next-generation wireless communication and Internet of Things (IoT) systems operating in the Terahertz (THz) frequency spectrum. Designed on a 160 × 160 μm² polyimide substrate, the antenna is analyzed using CST-2018 simulations and RLC circuit modeling.

pmc-12681927.title: Near-infrared photoimmunotherapy for effective elimination of ovarian cancer cells by inducing immunogenic cell death
pmc-12681927.creator: TM Mohiuddin, Chaoyu Zhang, Wenjie Sheng, Marwah Al-Rawe, Roland Schmitz, Marcus Niebert, Natalia El-Merhie, Felix Zeppernick, Ivo Meinhold-Heerlein, Ahmad Fawzi Hussain
pmc-12681927.description: Ovarian cancer represents one of the most common forms of female gynecological cancer. The existing treatment modalities include surgery and chemotherapy, which are unable to treat local and long-distant micro-metastases. Near-infrared photoimmunotherapy (NIR-PIT) is a newly developed treatment strategy that can selectively kill the cancer cells and induce immunogenic cell death and thereby stimulate anti-tumor immune responses.

pmc-13197348.title: Prevalence and characteristics of dental and periodontal disease in Western European hedgehogs (Erinaceus europaeus) admitted into an animal shelter in northwestern Germany
pmc-13197348.creator: Ines Stegmaier-Länge, Gidona Goodman, Lian Thomas
pmc-13197348.description: Dental and periodontal disease are common findings in Western European hedgehogs (Erinaceus europaeus) admitted into rehabilitation but are rarely studied. This study aimed to collect data on the prevalence and characteristics of dental and periodontal disease in Western European hedgehogs admitted into an animal shelter in northwestern Germany.

pmc-13348896.title: Developing and Testing the Validity of a Needs-Based Communication Program for New Korean Nurses’ Organizational Adaptation
pmc-13348896.creator: Jung-ha Park, Heejung Yu
pmc-13348896.description: Background:We developed a needs-based communication program for fostering the organizational adaptation of new Korean nurses. It tested the program’s effects on their intentions to stay in their job, burnout, fear of negative evaluations, self-encouragement, workplace friendships, communication, and nonviolent communication.Methods:The communication program was developed based on the nonviolent communication approach.

pmc-13467410.title: Protective Effects of Ranolazine in a Rat Model of Ovarian Ischemia/Reperfusion Injury
pmc-13467410.creator: Mesut Admis, Esra Tuba Sezgin, Zeynep Suleyman, Ozlem Admis, Mustafa Ozkaraca, Ali Gungor, Aydin Aliyev, Halis Suleyman
pmc-13467410.description: Ovarian ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) injury is a major cause of tissue damage following the surgical detorsion of ovarian torsion and is characterized by excessive oxidative stress, inflammation, and progressive cellular injury. Although ranolazine has been reported to exert antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects in various experimental models, its potential protective effects against ovarian I/R injury have not yet been investigated.

pmc-13580634.title: Adrenal suppression secondary to inhaled corticosteroids
pmc-13580634.creator: Corin MacPhail, Elizabeth Rosolowsky, Connie Yang, Teresa Pinto, Carly Baxter, Anne Hicks
pmc-13580634.description: Inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) are the foundation of treatment for pediatric asthma, and ICS are significantly safer than repeated courses of systemic steroids. However, systemic effects from ICS include adrenal suppression (AS), which is under recognized and can be life-threatening. Signs and symptoms of AS are often subtle and can be difficult to recognize.
